title: 第65章 你究竟对我妹妹做了什么？

content_zh: 唐逸随手将皮鞭丢在赵安面前。赵安下意识向后缩了一下。意识到自己竟然对唐逸生出恐惧，他顿感屈辱。抬头看向唐逸，赵安一张脸都扭曲了起来。“呵呵，哈哈……凭你，也敢屡次三番挑衅我们二处？”“我们二处要杀的人，天王老子都保不住，凭你，也配？”赵安挣扎着爬了起来，往地上吐了一口血沫。“这三十六鞭，我给你记着。”“好好活着，这鞭子……我会千倍万倍地还给你的。”话落，赵安大笑着离开了监牢。萧棣见到这一幕，很不满：“这种人不宰了，留着过年呢？”要是他，早唰唰几道砍了，哪有那么多事。唐逸睨了萧棣一眼，冷笑道：“谁说不宰的，但让他这样死了，那太便宜他了。”“我要让他们好好尝一下，什么叫真正的恐惧！”看着唐逸的笑容，萧棣脊背莫名一阵发凉。眼前这家伙本来就阴险，加上有父皇做后盾，还别说二处这次可能还真就踢到铁板了。“别想太多，我不会玩阴的。”唐逸看出萧棣的心思，瞪了他一眼道：“我们现在是锦衣卫，我们是执法者，那我们首先要做的就是遵纪守法。”“真要在这里杀了赵安他们，那我们和赵安他们又有什么区别呢？”“他们既然看不起法，将律法玩弄于股掌之中，草菅人命……那我们，就用法来收拾他们。”唐逸决定，将二处这些年办的案子全部复查一遍。只要有冤假错案，那他们就死定了。萧棣抬手拍了拍脑袋，有些烦躁。哎呀烦死了，最讨厌这些条条框框了。“我说，你们……你们……你们是不是把我忘了？”“这里，还有一个人。”柳公瑾虚弱的声音传来。“呃……舅舅，我在呢。”唐逸连忙跑过去，将柳公瑾扶了起来。此时，柳公瑾遍体鳞伤，已经是个血人，没有了曾经沉稳儒雅的半点影子。唐逸握着柳公瑾的手，目光森冷：“舅舅，你放心，你今日受到的伤害，我会千倍百倍还给他们。”“不，不，不要……”柳公瑾很虚弱，死死抓住唐逸的手。他冲着唐逸摇了摇头，道：“户部……户部的案子，没你想象的那么简单，别……别掺和进来。”“这个案子涉及太大，没人能办得了的。”“谁办，谁死……”柳公瑾身体微微颤抖，被打得遍体鳞伤，他都没叫一声。但现在想到户部的案子，他却忍不住颤抖。唐逸一怔，果然，舅舅知道一些内幕的。“舅舅，把你知道的告诉我……”唐逸刚开口，柳公瑾拼尽全力，将他推开。“胡闹，牵扯太大，真查下去朝堂肯定不稳。”“到时候皇帝要是翻脸不认人，极有可能会将查案的人推出来祭天，以平息群臣的怒火。”“你参与进来，十死无生！”萧棣摸了摸鼻，别胡说，我爹是那种人吗？好吧，我爹……还真是！唐逸指了指萧棣，道：“舅舅放心，这位就是当朝四皇子，是我的……呃，顶头上司，就算到时候查不下去，背锅也轮不到我，有他顶着。”咳咳，我只是个小人物！柳公瑾沉吟了一下，看了一眼牢头。萧棣会意，冲着牢头道：“看什么看，还不去安排一间干净的牢房，再烧一桶水和拿几身干净的囚服过来。”牢头连连称是，带着狱卒走了。柳公瑾握住唐逸的手，道：“小逸，舅舅知道的也不多，但我觉得顾城的死，和国债有关。”“这些年，很多大臣从户部借的银子，账都是顾城做的。”“而他做的账，极有可能是假账……现在他死了，那些大臣要还给户部的银子，恐怕就是假账上的数目。”“那可是足足相差几倍甚至数十倍的账目！”一听这话，萧棣当场跳了起来，满脸怒火：“草，那是国库的银子，是国家的钱。”“他们拿国家的钱，还敢做假账？他们是疯了吧？”唐逸没理萧棣，脸色已经凝重起来。难怪舅舅说牵扯太广，这案子要查下去，恐怕真相大白会得罪一大票大臣啊！可要是不查……不查就得脑袋落地，还得连累一处全员裸奔。他已经没有退路了。“舅舅，放心吧，我心里有数。”唐逸安慰了一下柳公瑾，便将柳公瑾背到了一间干净的牢房。又给柳公瑾清洗了伤口，取出口袋中蒸馏好的一小瓶酒精帮其消毒。看着唐逸认真熟稔的样子，将萧棣看得一愣一愣。“呃，原来你真会医术啊！”萧棣终于放心了。原本还有一点点怀疑，以为这小子是想占妹妹便宜呢。毕竟妹妹那么漂亮，自己家的好白菜，可不能便宜猪。“不是太懂，也只会一点皮毛而已。”唐逸无语，感情这家伙到现在都没有完全相信他。这时，宁川带着孙有道也来到了牢房外。见到唐逸，孙有道眼睛亮得吓人。哦豁，这不是那天晚上救公主的小神医吗？当晚他对小公主又亲又摸的，就把公主救回来了。他这几日冥思苦想，愣是没想明白到底是怎么回事。想要找小神医问清楚，但想到皇帝那天晚上摆的臭脸，只好作罢。但现在遇上了，陛下总不能还拿保密来收拾他吧？“小神医，小神医，真的是你啊！”孙有道快步向着唐逸走了过去，满脸激动：“小神医，我总算是见到你了，你不知道，这几日我都快想死你了。”咕咚！唐逸看着眼前的孙有道，下意识地咽了咽口水。老先生我们认识吗？什么叫想死我了？不知道的还以为我们有一腿呢。萧棣立即凑过来，满脸八卦。站在门外的宁川和锦衣卫一处的人，却是满脸错愕。孙有道的脾气有多臭他们是知道的，单单请他过来这一趟，就被他骂了一路了。结果，现在竟然对唐逸和颜悦色，甚至还有那么几分的讨好。就特娘的因为唐逸会点医术，救了公主？“老夫孙有道，太医院院使。”孙有道冲着唐逸微微拱手，迫不及待地问道：“小神医，你快给老夫说说，你当晚救澜儿公主的原理。”“为什么又摸又抱又亲，就能将已经没有了脉搏和心跳的公主殿下，从鬼门关拉回来？”全场瞬间一片死寂。萧棣面色脸色僵硬，原本想凑过来听唐逸和孙有道之间有什么大瓜的。没想到吃瓜吃到了自己身上了。又摸又亲又抱？妈的唐逸，你究竟对我妹妹做了什么？！
content_en: Tang Yi casually threw the whip in front of Zhao An.Zhao An subconsciously shrank back.Realizing that he was actually afraid of Tang Yi, he felt humiliated.Looking up at Tang Yi, Zhao An's face became distorted."Haha, haha... How dare you repeatedly provoke our Second Division?" "I can't even protect the people our Second Division wants to kill, but you are worthy of it?" Zhao An struggled to get up and spat a mouthful of blood on the ground."I will remember these thirty-six lashes for you." "Live well, and this lash... I will return it to you a thousand times." After saying this, Zhao An laughed and left the prison.When Xiao Di saw this scene, he was very dissatisfied: "If you don't kill this kind of person, why don't you keep it for the New Year?" If he had just chopped it off a few times, how could there be so many things?Tang Yi glanced at Xiao Di and sneered: "Who said he wouldn't kill him, but letting him die like this is too easy for him." "I want them to have a good taste, what is real fear!" Looking at Tang Yi's smile, Xiao Di felt an inexplicable chill down his spine.The guy in front of him was already sinister, and with his father's backing, not to mention the fact that the Second Office might really hit the wall this time."Don't think too much, I won't play dirty tricks." Tang Yi saw Xiao Di's thoughts, glared at him and said: "We are Jin Yiwei now, we are law enforcers, so the first thing we have to do is abide by the law." "If we really want to kill Zhao An and the others here, thenWhat's the difference between us and Zhao An?""Since they despise the law and take advantage of the law, we will use the law to deal with them." Tang Yi decided to review all the cases handled by the Second Division over the years.As long as there is an unjust, false or wrongful conviction, they will be dead.Xiao Di raised his hand and patted his head, feeling a little irritated.Oops, it's so annoying. I hate these rules and regulations."I said, you... you... have you forgotten me?" "There is another person here." Liu Gongjin's weak voice came."Uh...Uncle, I'm here." Tang Yi quickly ran over and helped Liu Gongjin up.At this time, Liu Gongjin was covered in bruises and was already a bloody man, without any shadow of his once calm and elegant character.Tang Yi held Liu Gongjin's hand with a cold gaze: "Uncle, don't worry, I will repay them a thousand times the harm you suffered today." "No, no, don't..." Liu Gongjin was very weak and held Tang Yi's hand tightly.He shook his head at Tang Yi and said: "Hu Bu... Hu Bu's case is not as simple as you think, don't... don't get involved." "This case involves too much, no one can handle it." "Whoever does it will die..." Liu Gongjin's body was shaking slightly, and he was beaten all over, and he didn't even scream.But now he couldn't help but tremble when he thought about the Hubu case.Tang Yi was startled. Sure enough, his uncle knew something inside."Uncle, tell me what you know..." As soon as Tang Yicao spoke, Liu Gongjin tried his best to push him away."It's nonsense, it involves too much, and the court will definitely be unstable if we really investigate." "If the emperor turns his back and refuses to recognize the person, it is very likely that the person who investigated the case will be pushed out to sacrifice to heaven to calm the anger of the officials." "If you get involved, you will die!" Xiao Di touched his nose, don't talk nonsense, is my father that kind of person?Well, my dad...it's true!Tang Yi pointed at Xiao Di and said: "Uncle, don't worry, this is the fourth prince of the current dynasty. He is my... er, immediate boss. Even if the investigation cannot be carried out by then, it will not be my turn to take the blame. He will bear the blame." Ahem, I'm just a nobody!Liu Gongjin pondered for a moment and glanced at the cell leader.Xiao Di understood and said to the cell leader: "What are you looking at? Why don't you arrange a clean cell? Then boil a bucket of water and bring some clean prison uniforms." The cell leader said yes again and again and left with the jailer.Liu Gongjin held Tang Yi's hand and said: "Xiaoyi, my uncle doesn't know much, but I think Gu Cheng's death is related to the national debt." "In recent years, many ministers have borrowed money from the Ministry of Revenue, and the accounts were done by Gu Cheng." "And the accounts he made are most likely false accounts... Now that he is dead, the money that those ministers have to return to the Ministry of Revenue will probably be the same.It's the amount in the false account."That's a difference of several times or even dozens of times!"When he heard this, Xiao Di jumped up on the spot, his face full of anger: "Fuck, that's money from the national treasury, it's the country's money.""They are taking the country's money, are they crazy?"Tang Yi ignored Xiao Di, his face became serious.No wonder my uncle said that the case was too involved and that if we continue to investigate the case, I am afraid that if the truth comes out, a lot of ministers will be offended!But if you don't check...if you don't check, your head will fall to the ground, and everyone will run naked in one place.There was no way out for him."Uncle, don't worry, I know what's going on." Tang Yi comforted Liu Gongjin and then carried Liu Gongjin to a clean cell.He cleaned Liu Gongjin's wound and took out a small bottle of distilled alcohol from his pocket to disinfect it.Seeing Tang Yi's serious and familiar look, Xiao Di was stunned for a moment."Well, it turns out you are really good at medicine!" Xiao Di finally felt relieved.I was a little suspicious at first, thinking that this guy was trying to take advantage of my sister.After all, my sister is so beautiful, and I can’t afford to be cheap with my good cabbage."I don't know much about it, and I only know a little bit about it." Tang Yi was speechless, and the guy in love still didn't completely believe him.At this time, Ning Chuan and Sun Youdao also came outside the cell.Seeing Tang Yi, Sun Youdao's eyes were frighteningly bright.Oh, isn't this the little miracle doctor who saved the princess that night?That night he kissed and touched the little princess and rescued her.He had been thinking hard these past few days, but he couldn't figure out what was going on.I wanted to ask the little miracle doctor to find out, but thinking about the bad face the emperor put on that night, I had to give up.But now that he has met him, His Majesty can't keep it secret to deal with him, right?"Little miraculous doctor, little miraculous doctor, it's really you!" Sun Youdao walked quickly towards Tang Yi, his face full of excitement: "Little miraculous doctor, I finally see you. You don't know, I have missed you so much these days." Gudong!Tang Yi looked at Sun Youdao in front of him and swallowed subconsciously.Do we know the old gentleman?What do you mean you miss me to death?Those who didn’t know thought we had an affair.Xiao Di immediately came over, his face full of gossip.Ning Chuan and Jin Yiwei were standing outside the door, but their faces were full of astonishment.They knew how bad Sun Youdao's temper was. Just by inviting him over, they got scolded all the way.As a result, now he is actually very fond of Tang Yi and Yan Yue, and even has some feelings for him.
title_en: Chapter 65 What exactly did you do to my sister?
